# Data dictionary

<!-- Generated by `uv run apple-health dictionary` from src/apple_health/schemas.py; do not edit. -->

Schema version 1. Files live under the warehouse directory (`warehouse/` by default): `<layer>/<table>.parquet` for the curated, derived and marts layers, or a directory of hive partitions for partitioned tables. Mart metrics are defined in `src/apple_health/marts/metrics.py`.

Conventions: `*_utc` columns are UTC instants; `*_local` columns are naive wall-clock times in the row's `tz_name`; `local_date` is the local calendar date. Ids are 16-hex-character BLAKE2b hashes of the row's natural key, stable across runs and exports. HealthKit `%` values are fractions (0.97 = 97 %).

Reading: `pl.scan_parquet('warehouse/curated/fct_quantity_sample', hive_partitioning=True)`.

## Curated layer

### `dim_data_type`

Every HealthKit sample type in the config registry or in the data.

**Primary key:** `type_identifier`

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `type_identifier` | string | Full HealthKit identifier (PK). |
| `type` | string | Short name (prefix stripped). |
| `kind` | string | quantity \| category. |
| `canonical_unit` | string | Unit of fct_quantity_sample.value for this type. |
| `aggregation` | string | cumulative (sum) \| discrete (mean/min/max) \| category \| null (unknown). |
| `min_plausible` | float64 | Lower plausible bound (config); outside -> is_outlier. |
| `max_plausible` | float64 | Upper plausible bound (config). |
| `is_known` | bool | Listed in config/types.toml. |
| `raw_units` | list[string] | Units seen in the export. |
| `n_raw_records` | int64 | Raw records of this type in the export (before dedup). |

### `dim_source`

Apps and devices that wrote data. source_name has the owner's name stripped.

**Primary key:** `source_id`

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `source_id` | string | PK: hash of the raw source name. |
| `source_name` | string | Normalised name, e.g. 'Apple Watch'. |
| `source_kind` | string | watch \| phone \| external_sensor \| apple_app \| third_party_app. |
| `priority_rank` | int32 | Lower wins when sources overlap (config sources.priority). |
| `source_name_raw` | string | Name as exported (may contain the owner's name; sensitive). |

### `dim_device`

Device models parsed from HKDevice strings (pointer and local identifiers/MACs dropped).

**Primary key:** `device_id`

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `device_id` | string | PK: hash(name, manufacturer, model, hardware). |
| `name` | string | Device name (owner's name stripped). |
| `manufacturer` | string |  |
| `model` | string |  |
| `hardware` | string | Hardware identifier, e.g. WatchN,M. |
| `device_class` | string | watch \| phone \| audio \| sensor \| other (heuristic). |

### `dim_category_value`

Category enum values with short labels and HealthKit ordinals.

**Primary key:** `type_identifier, category_value`

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `type_identifier` | string | Category type. |
| `type` | string | Short type name. |
| `category_value` | string | Raw enum value, e.g. HKCategoryValueSleepAnalysisAsleepCore. |
| `label` | string | Short label, e.g. Core. |
| `ordinal` | int32 | HealthKit raw value where configured. |
| `is_known` | bool | Configured in config/types.toml. |
| `n_raw_records` | int64 | Raw records with this value (before deduplication). |

### `dim_timezone_period`

Inferred time-zone timeline from HKTimeZone evidence (workouts, sleep).

**Primary key:** `period_nr`

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `period_nr` | int32 | PK, chronological. |
| `tz_name` | string | IANA zone. |
| `valid_from_utc` | timestamp (UTC) | Period start (midpoint to the previous period's evidence). |
| `valid_to_utc` | timestamp (UTC) | Period end (midpoint to the next period's evidence). |
| `first_evidence_utc` | timestamp (UTC) |  |
| `last_evidence_utc` | timestamp (UTC) |  |
| `n_evidence` | int64 | Number of tagged samples/workouts in the period. |

### `fct_quantity_sample`

One row per quantity record after deduplication. Values in the type's canonical unit (HealthKit '%' values are fractions 0-1). Partitioned by type.

**Primary key:** `sample_id`  
**Partitioned by:** `type` (hive layout `fct_quantity_sample/type=<value>/`)  
**References:** `source_id` → `dim_source.source_id`, `device_id` → `dim_device.device_id`, `type_identifier` → `dim_data_type.type_identifier`

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `sample_id` | string | Stable id: hash(type, source, start, end, value, unit). |
| `record_nr` | int64 | Lineage: stg_record.record_nr of the surviving raw row. |
| `type` | string | Short type name, e.g. HeartRate. |
| `type_identifier` | string | Full HealthKit identifier. |
| `source_id` | string | FK dim_source. |
| `device_id` | string | FK dim_device (null when the record has no device). |
| `source_version` | string | Version of the writing app/OS. |
| `device_software` | string | Software/firmware version of the device at write time. |
| `value` | float64 | Value in canonical_unit. |
| `unit` | string | Canonical unit. |
| `raw_unit` | string | Unit as exported. |
| `start_utc` | timestamp (UTC) | Start instant (UTC). |
| `end_utc` | timestamp (UTC) | End instant (UTC). |
| `created_utc` | timestamp (UTC) | When the sample was written to HealthKit (UTC). |
| `duration_s` | float64 | end_utc - start_utc in seconds (0 for instantaneous samples). |
| `tz_name` | string | IANA zone used for local times. |
| `tz_source` | string | explicit (HKTimeZone on the row) \| inferred (dim_timezone_period) \| default (config). |
| `start_local` | timestamp (local, naive) | Local wall-clock start in tz_name. |
| `end_local` | timestamp (local, naive) | Local wall-clock end in tz_name. |
| `local_date` | date | Local calendar date of the start. |
| `dup_count` | int32 | Raw rows collapsed into this one by deduplication (1 = unique). |
| `is_outlier` | bool | Value outside the plausible range of the type (kept, flagged). |
| `is_priority_source` | bool | Source has the best priority among sources with this type in the same local hour. |
| `hk_time_zone` | string | Promoted from metadata key 'HKTimeZone'. |
| `hr_motion_context` | int64 | Promoted from metadata key 'HKMetadataKeyHeartRateMotionContext'. |
| `sync_identifier` | string | Promoted from metadata key 'HKMetadataKeySyncIdentifier'. |
| `algorithm_version` | int64 | Promoted from metadata key 'HKAlgorithmVersion'. |
| `audio_exposure_level_dbaspl` | float64 | Promoted from metadata key 'HKMetadataKeyAudioExposureLevel'. |
| `heart_rate_event_threshold_bpm` | float64 | Promoted from metadata key 'HKHeartRateEventThreshold'. |
| `export_id` | string | Export this row comes from (export timestamp, UTC ISO-8601). |

### `fct_sample_metadata`

Every metadata entry of every surviving sample (long format).

### `fct_route_point`

GPS points of workout routes. Sentinel values (-1) are nulled and flagged; nothing is dropped except exact duplicate points. Partitioned by year.

**Primary key:** `route_id, seq`  
**Partitioned by:** `year` (hive layout `fct_route_point/year=<value>/`)  
**References:** `route_id` → `fct_workout_route.route_id`

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `route_id` | string | FK fct_workout_route. |
| `seq` | int64 | Position within the GPX file. |
| `file_name` | string | Lineage: GPX file. |
| `ts_utc` | timestamp (UTC) | Point timestamp (UTC, from GPX). |
| `ts_local` | timestamp (local, naive) | Local time in the workout's zone. |
| `lat` | float64 | Latitude (WGS84). |
| `lon` | float64 | Longitude (WGS84). |
| `elevation_m` | float64 | Elevation; null when vAcc < 0 (invalid altitude). |
| `speed_mps` | float64 | Speed in m/s; null when < 0. |
| `course_deg` | float64 | Course in degrees; null when < 0 (invalid). |
| `h_acc_m` | float64 | Horizontal accuracy (m). |
| `v_acc_m` | float64 | Vertical accuracy (m); null when < 0. |
| `segment_dist_m` | float64 | Haversine distance to the previous point of the route (m). |
| `invalid_course` | bool |  |
| `invalid_altitude` | bool |  |
| `speed_outlier` | bool | speed_mps above routes.max_speed_mps. |
| `low_accuracy` | bool | h_acc_m above routes.max_horizontal_accuracy_m. |
| `year` | int64 | Partition: UTC year of ts_utc. |

## Derived layer

### `agg_quantity_hourly`

Quantity samples per type and local hour (start time). Overlapping sources of cumulative types are resolved by source priority per hour.

**Primary key:** `type, local_date, hour`

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `type` | string | Short type name. |
| `local_date` | date |  |
| `hour` | int32 | Local hour of the sample start (0-23). |
| `aggregation` | string | cumulative \| discrete (from dim_data_type; unknown types are treated as discrete). |
| `unit` | string | Canonical unit. |
| `value` | float64 | cumulative: sum over the priority source(s) of each local hour; discrete: mean of all samples. |
| `value_min` | float64 | Smallest sample value (all sources). |
| `value_max` | float64 | Largest sample value (all sources). |
| `n_samples` | int64 | Samples contributing (all sources). |
| `n_sources` | int32 | Distinct sources with samples. |
| `n_outliers` | int64 | Samples flagged is_outlier (included in the values). |
| `value_all_sources_sum` | float64 | cumulative only: naive sum over all sources (double-counts overlapping sources). |
| `sources_used` | list[string] | cumulative: source(s) whose values make up `value`. |

### `agg_quantity_daily`

Quantity samples per type and local date. Cumulative: sum of the priority-resolved hourly values. Discrete: statistics over all samples.

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|

### `mart_daily`

One row per local calendar day from the first to the last day with data (no gaps; days without data have nulls). Sleep columns describe the night that ENDS on this day. Activity totals resolve overlapping sources per hour. Use is_valid_wear_day to exclude days the Watch was barely worn.

### `mart_baselines`

Personal baselines per metric and day, over valid wear days only (analytics.baseline_metrics).

**Primary key:** `metric, local_date`

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `local_date` | date | Local date. |
| `metric` | string | mart_daily column name. |
| `value` | float64 | The day's value. |
| `roll_short_median` | float64 | Rolling median over analytics.rolling_short_days (7) days. |
| `roll_long_median` | float64 | Rolling median over analytics.rolling_long_days (28) days. |
| `normal_p10` | float64 | Rolling 10th percentile over analytics.normal_range_days (90): the low end of your normal. |
| `normal_p50` | float64 | Rolling median over the same window. |
| `normal_p90` | float64 | Rolling 90th percentile: the high end of your normal. |
| `baseline_mean` | float64 | Mean over the previous analytics.baseline_days (60) days, today excluded. |
| `baseline_sd` | float64 | Standard deviation over the same window. |
| `z` | float64 | (value - baseline_mean) / baseline_sd; null with fewer than baseline_min_days days. |

### `mart_run_split`

Per-kilometre splits of runs with GPS (last split may be partial).

**Primary key:** `workout_id, split`

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `workout_id` | string | FK mart_run. |
| `split` | int32 | 1-based kilometre. |
| `distance_m` | float64 | Distance of the split (1000 except possibly the last). |
| `duration_s` | float64 |  |
| `pace_s_per_km` | float64 |  |
| `elevation_change_m` | float64 | End minus start elevation (valid altitudes only). |
| `avg_hr_bpm` | float64 | Mean heart-rate sample within the split. |
| `start_offset_s` | float64 | Seconds since the start of the run. |

### `mart_reference`

Population and guideline reference bands for the profile's age and sex (config/references.toml). Bands step at age-group boundaries: valid_from/valid_to say when each applies.

**Primary key:** `metric, kind, valid_from, band`

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `metric` | string | Reference metric key (e.g. resting_hr, sleep_duration). |
| `kind` | string | range (guideline or clinical bands) or percentile (population percentile table). |
| `band` | string | Band id within its set (e.g. normal, p25_p50). |
| `label` | string | Short label for display (e.g. 60–100 bpm, 25th–50th percentile). |
| `lo` | float64 | Lower bound, inclusive, in warehouse units; null = open. |
| `hi` | float64 | Upper bound, exclusive; null = open. |
| `is_target` | bool | The recommended or typical band. |
| `is_warning` | bool | A band the source calls abnormal or not recommended. |
| `valid_from` | date | First local date the band applies (age group start, within the export). |
| `valid_to` | date | Last local date the band applies. |
| `population` | string | Who the numbers describe (e.g. Women aged 30–39, FRIEND registry). |
| `source_id` | string | mart_reference_source.source_id. |
| `seq` | int32 | Band order within its set, from low to high values. |

### `mart_reference_source`

Citations behind mart_reference.

**Primary key:** `source_id`

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `source_id` | string | Source key in config/references.toml. |
| `short` | string | Short name shown next to a band (e.g. WHO 2020). |
| `citation` | string | Full citation. |
| `url` | string | DOI or web address. |
| `note` | string | How the source was measured and how it compares with Apple's measurement. |

## Staging layer

Lossless mirrors of the source elements: attribute columns keep the source's camelCase names and raw string values; `*_nr`/`ordinal` columns are integer lineage keys. Use the curated layer for analysis.

| Table | Description |
|---|---|
| `stg_export` | One row describing the export (export date, locale, format version). |
| `stg_me` | Profile characteristics (<Me> attributes), one row per attribute. |
| `stg_record` | Top-level <Record> elements. |
| `stg_record_metadata` | <MetadataEntry> children of top-level records. |
| `stg_hrv_beat` | <InstantaneousBeatsPerMinute> of heart-rate-variability records. |
| `stg_workout` | <Workout> elements. |
| `stg_workout_metadata` | <MetadataEntry> of workouts and their activities, events and routes (owner_kind = workout | activity | event | route; owner_ordinal = that child's ordinal). |
| `stg_workout_activity` | <WorkoutActivity> children of workouts (e.g. intervals). |
| `stg_workout_event` | <WorkoutEvent> of workouts and activities (activity_ordinal null at workout level). |
| `stg_workout_statistic` | <WorkoutStatistics> of workouts and activities. |
| `stg_workout_zone` | <WorkoutZone> rows with their <WorkoutZoneGroup> attributes. |
| `stg_workout_route` | <WorkoutRoute> elements with their <FileReference> path. |
| `stg_workout_record_ref` | <Record> elements nested in workouts. They duplicate top-level records and are only used to link workouts to samples. |
| `stg_activity_summary` | <ActivitySummary> elements (one per day). |
| `stg_audiogram` | <Audiogram> elements. |
| `stg_audiogram_metadata` | <MetadataEntry> of audiograms. |
| `stg_audiogram_point` | <SensitivityPoint> of audiograms. |
| `stg_other_element` | Any element without a dedicated table (unknown or DTD-declared-but-unhandled), kept as XML so nothing is lost. parent_nr is the *_nr of the parent element (null at top level). |
| `stg_gpx_file` | One row per GPX file in workout-routes/. |
| `stg_gpx_point` | <trkpt> elements of all GPX files, in file order (seq), with Apple extension values. |
